propositions: git commit --amend -F/-m replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a fresh Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
Git hooks cannot distinguish between a fresh -F commit and an -F amend, so prepare-commit-msg cannot preserve Change-Id during amend operations
A make amend-msg wrapper target must read HEAD's Change-Id, amend with the new message file contents, and preserve the original Change-Id via git interpret-trailers
The wrapper must fail loudly and non-zero when HEAD carries no Change-Id rather than silently creating a commit that will be stamped with a fresh one
AGENTS.md must document make amend-msg as the required path for rewritten commit messages and explicitly warn that --amend -m/-F drop Change-Id and create duplicate Gerrit changes
